text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus mistimed her move. The one 
who won the race was Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Ikuno Dictus realizes once again 
that experience is a powerful weapon. And 
so, she resolved to grow even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Yasuda Kinen. Ikuno 
Dictus's fatigue was lower than 
anticipated. The Trainer feels her 
undeniable growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And next up is finally the Takarazuka 
Kinen. The grand finale of the Senior Year 
spring goals.
